As Tiffany & Co New (TIF) Stock Price Declined, Shareholder Jana Partners Has Boosted Its Holding; Enbridge (ENB) Shareholder Donaldson Capital Management Cut Its Holding by $517,413 as Valuation Declined
May 17, 2018 - By Clifton Ray
Barry Rosenstein increased its stake in Tiffany & Co New (TIF) by 5009.07% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Jana Partners Llc bought 3.69M shares as the company’s stock declined 6.13% with the market. The hedge fund run by Barry Rosenstein held 3.76 million shares of the consumer specialties company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $390.88M, up from 73,600 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Jana Partners Llc who had been investing in Tiffany & Co New for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $12.94 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 0.13% or $0.14 during the last trading session, reaching $103.91. About 1.07 million shares traded. Tiffany & Co. (NYSE:TIF) has risen 1.55% since May 17, 2017 and is uptrending. It has underperformed by 10.00% the S&P500.
Donaldson Capital Management Llc decreased its stake in Enbridge Incorporated (ENB) by 2.47% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Donaldson Capital Management Llc sold 13,267 shares as the company’s stock declined 21.20% with the market. The institutional investor held 524,604 shares of the natural gas distribution company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $20.52M, down from 537,871 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Donaldson Capital Management Llc who had been investing in Enbridge Incorporated for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $55.84 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.76% or $0.25 during the last trading session, reaching $32.95. About 4.97 million shares traded or 34.07% up from the average. Enbridge Inc. (NYSE:ENB) has declined 26.13% since May 17, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 37.68% the S&P500.
Donaldson Capital Management Llc, which manages about $967.55M and $1.03 billion US Long portfolio, upped its stake in Pnc Fin Serv Grp (NYSE:PNC) by 30,267 shares to 197,517 shares, valued at $28.50 million in 2017Q4, according to the filing. It also increased its holding in Marsh & Mclennan Companies Inc (NYSE:MMC) by 9,796 shares in the quarter, for a total of 313,622 shares, and has risen its stake in Lockheed Martin Corp (NYSE:LMT).

Among 16 analysts covering Enbridge Inc. ( NYSE:ENB ), 6 have Buy rating, 0 Sell and 10 Hold. Therefore 38% are positive. Enbridge Inc. had 25 analyst reports since August 4, 2015 according to SRatingsIntel. The company was maintained on Friday, November 17 by Morgan Stanley. J.P. Morgan initiated the stock with “Hold” rating in Friday, June 23 report. JP Morgan reinitiated the stock with “Neutral” rating in Friday, June 23 report. On Monday, April 3 the stock rating was maintained by Wells Fargo with “Market Perform”. The firm has “Equal-Weight” rating given on Friday, July 14 by Morgan Stanley. On Thursday, September 1 the stock rating was initiated by Bank of America with “Neutral”. The stock has “Outperform” rating by BMO Capital Markets on Friday, October 23. RBC Capital Markets maintained the shares of ENB in report on Friday, October 9 with “Outperform” rating. The firm has “Neutral” rating given on Thursday, February 4 by Credit Suisse. As per Tuesday, December 15, the company rating was initiated by JP Morgan.
Analysts await Enbridge Inc. (NYSE:ENB) to report earnings on August, 2. They expect $0.38 EPS, up 26.67% or $0.08 from last year’s $0.3 per share. ENB’s profit will be $644.02M for 21.68 P/E if the $0.38 EPS becomes a reality. After $0.82 actual EPS reported by Enbridge Inc. for the previous quarter, Wall Street now forecasts -53.66% negative EPS growth.
